sources.title: reaperdoesntknow/SMOLM2Prover-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: With LM Studio Download SMOLM2Prover-Q4_K_M.gguf Place in LM Studio models folder Load and chat! Quantization Details The Q4_K_M quantization uses: Q4_K for most weights Q5_0 fallback for tensors not divisible by 256 Q6_K/Q8_0 for some critical layers Size reduction: 692M → 258M (63% smaller) BPW: 5.94 bits per weight License Same as the original model.
